_readme: List the source files that implement each canvas screen. check-icons.mjs reads this file. `inProgress` lists the files of screens that are built but do not yet match the canvas (docs/plans/canvas-gap-audit-2026-10-20.md); check-icons ignores it. Move a screen into `screens` when check-icons passes for it. `superseded` lists canvas boards replaced by newer ones (not built): `by` names the screens that replace them, `source` where the decision is recorded, `redirects` the old app URLs that now land on the replacement. check-icons passes a superseded screen by naming its successor, reports it as superseded, and fails if an entry is inconsistent.
